title: A Fantastic Bike Tour
text: We had a fantastic bike tour! Fanette was a wonderful guide, very friendly and knowledgeable, and shared so many interesting stories and facts along the way. This was our second time doing this tour, and it definitely didn’t disappoint. We had a great time again and would highly recommend it!
author: Y7145OMannickb

title: Excellent Tour!!!
text: Fannette was an excellent guide. The tour ended up with the hubby and I so it was a private tour! She provided historical context which we hadn’t heard before so this made it a really useful tour - wished we had taken it on our first day instead of our last day. Also, we were able to experience sights we wouldn’t have been able to see if we had relied on foot/public transportation. It was our first time on a Segway and by the end of the tour, we were zipping around like pros - as Fanette mentioned, once you zip around Granada and its slopes, you can zip around anywhere in the world! Many thank
author: glendaj351

author: wilkins66

title: Tip Top with Teens
text: Our first segway ride in the steep old quarter of Granada’s albaicin. Simon Francophone guide patiently helped us to take control of the machines... he adapted to our rhythm, guided us very nicely for our discovery of this superb city.
author: Marion M

title: Segway tours are great!
text: Had a one hour Segway tour with Fares as our guide and it was brilliant. It is such a great way to see a city. Fares was an excellent guide - looked after us, told us about the history of Granada in excellent English and showed us Sacromonte on a beautiful sunny day. Good Segways too that managed the hills beautifully.
author: GilandDav

title: Great experience
text:
Great experience!
This allows to visit beautiful places inaccessible by car.
Many thanks to Fanette for her sympathy and all her explanations about the city.
My son (12) also loved it! It is a very fun visit

title: Simon is a Great Tour Guide
text: The tour was amazing we had Simon and he was very kind and very knowledgeable! I recommend for people who have never been on a Segway.
author: N5794RFdouglasp

title: A great tour of Granada
text: A great panoramic tour of Granada. Fares was patience, knowledgeable and a great guide. A must do in Granada! Fantastic views of the Alhambra Palace thrown in.!!
author: kinnairdt

title: Best way to explore Arabic quarter in the heat
text: Had a wonderful tour of the Arabic quarter with a nice guide called Fanette. She was very skilled and taught us all to ride the Segways, none of us had been on one before. We all picked it up easily and had a great ride, the only problem was going down the steep hill for my youngest child, he is quiet light so could not so she rode in front of him and helped.
author: GreyS_11

title: Family fun on Segways
text: We had a brilliant tour with Fares, who was incredibly knowledge, helpful and kind. The Segways are a great way to cover a lot of Granada quickly and were a lot of fun. Thank you for an excellent time!
